newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei drops below 21,000 in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei drops below 21,000 in early morning.

text.p: The Tokyo Nikkei dropped below the 21,000 level in early morning trade on Tuesday for the first time since September 17, brokers said. They said that despite the Dow's the brief rise overnight past the 6,000 level, investors were on the sidelines waiting for the listing of JR West shares, weakening sentiment.
As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was down 191.65 points or 0.91 percent at 20,969.36. Its December futures were down 130 points at 21,070.
"The market will regain some confidence if the new JR shares start off above the public offer price of 357,000 yen," said Yoshihiro Ito, general manager at Okasan Securities.
"If the initial price falls below that then there is a chance the Nikkei average may slip," he added.
